name.description:
The name of an Action.Engine consists of the following parts:
{@link Action.Engine#runtime runtime}, {@link Action.Engine#languageVersion language version}, {@link Action.Engine#location location}, and {@link Action.Engine#executor executor}.
A test action engine which can run tests will end with the suffix "-test".
For example, the action engine "py-data_312-server-jep" has:
 - runtime: py-data_312
 - languageVersion: 3.12
 - location: SERVER
 - executor: JEP
The action engine "py.3.12-foo-server-py4j" has:
 - runtime: py-foo
 - languageVersion: 3.12
 - location: SERVER
 - executor: Py4J

name: Action.Engine
